annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: President of the United States (The White House)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order of 11 December 2025 establishing a policy of minimally burdensome national AI regulation and countering state AI laws. It creates a DOJ AI Litigation Task Force, orders a Commerce evaluation of state laws, conditions BEAD and grant funding, and directs FCC and FTC actions and a preemption legislative recommendation.
key_provisions_or_claims: DOJ AI Litigation Task Force to challenge state AI laws within 30 days
Commerce to publish evaluation of onerous state AI laws within 90 days
BEAD non-deployment funds and discretionary grants conditioned on states not enforcing conflicting AI laws
FCC to consider federal AI reporting and disclosure standard preempting state laws; FTC to issue policy statement on preemption
Legislative recommendation for uniform federal framework, excluding child safety, data center infrastructure and state procurement
